verdict.rationale: The only retention-related evidence is Lorikeet's zero-data-retention agreements with its model vendors. That is a vendor-side data-handling commitment, not a control that lets users set retention periods or delete their data. No documented retention settings, deletion workflows, or deletion APIs appear in the pack, so the capability is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Zero-data-retention agreements with all model vendors and no fine-tuning on customer data.
